drivers.title: Solana Set for Another Tokenized Stock Venue as Formation Notifies the SEC
drivers.detail: Operating under the SEC’s “Innovation Exemption,” the firm plans to list tokenized shares of Exodus, Forward Industries, and Galaxy Digital in early 2027, with the same voting and dividend rights as real stock. (Decrypt, CoinDesk, The Block are covering it.)

drivers.title: NYSE Taps Avalanche to Settle Its Planned Tokenized Stock Platform
drivers.detail: Ava Labs said Avalanche will serve as the “core ledger technology” for the clearing firm behind the NYSE-affiliated venue, which aims to bring 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement of tokenized securities onchain. (Decrypt, The Block are covering it.)

drivers.title: Strategy buys 1,036 Bitcoin as BTC holdings climb to 850,364
drivers.detail: Strategy bought $81.9 million in Bitcoin last week while spending $188.3 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, according to its latest SEC filing. (Cointelegraph, The Block are covering it.)

drivers.title: Trump says he knows ‘nothing’ about World Liberty’s UAE ties as Justin Sun challenges filings
drivers.detail: Trump confirmed he co-owns World Liberty, whose UAE ownership could derail Justin Sun’s federal lawsuit over frozen WLFI tokens (CoinDesk, Decrypt are covering it.)

drivers.title: Coinbase Joins Circle, Ripple With Final OCC Approval for Federal Trust Bank Charter
drivers.detail: The exchange will move its institutional crypto custody business under federal oversight, building on its 2018 New York trust charter. (Decrypt, Cointelegraph are covering it.)
